session_and_observation_contract.independent_sessions: Sandbox.unboxed_run sessions obtain pg_backend_pid; each named holder and contender pair asserts distinct backend IDs.
session_and_observation_contract.blocker_observed_before_release: await_blocker!/4 polls pg_blocking_pids(contender) until it equals the expected holder PID; the test releases the holder only after this returns.
session_and_observation_contract.durable_observation_limit: Wait and contention tests use distinct PostgreSQL sessions and then assert committed current row, grant/token, or audit outcomes in their test observer. Focused rollback tests that do not create an explicit holder/contender pair assert transaction rollback in the test transaction. This is not the configured packaged-adapter independent rollback observation assigned to plan 166-08.

schedules.test_ref: test/lockspire/storage/management_token_replacement_race_test.exs: same-fingerprint PUT/PUT, PUT/recovery, recovery/PUT, and recovery/recovery have one winner; a losing legacy promotion cannot restore advisory dates or version zero
schedules.post_wait_check: After the first writer commits, the blocked management operation revalidates current-row identity. Exactly one fingerprint winner remains valid; the loser is invalid, does not add an audit event, and legacy promotion does not restore version zero/advisory dates.
durable_assertions: current management-token hash verifies only the winner
loser token rejected
exactly one winner audit after contention
current lifecycle version and deadlines preserved
subsequent authorized replacement succeeds

schedules.test_ref: test/lockspire/storage/management_token_mutation_race_test.exs: stale included secret rejected after wait; omitted secret preserves committed rotation; host recovery preserves committed rotation; committed disablement survives PUT/recovery; contended write/audit failures roll back promotion
schedules.post_wait_check: PUT/recovery rereads current secret, enabled state, and current row after the lock. Stale credential material is rejected; omitted material retains the winning rotation; neither stale management update nor recovery re-enables a disabled client.
durable_assertions: secret hash and verifier retain the committed rotation
disabled state remains false after stale rejection/recovery
rejection adds no success audit
injected write/audit failure leaves client promotion and audit state unchanged
no replacement token disclosed on failure

schedules.test_ref: test/lockspire/storage/client_secret_lifetime_rotation_race_test.exs plus test/lockspire/storage/client_secret_lifetime_client_wait_test.exs and client_secret_lifetime_grant_wait_test.exs: authorized replacements serialize; post-wait current credential/time is checked at client, authorization-code, refresh-family, device, CIBA, and exchange waits
schedules.post_wait_check: Each holder/contender gets its own PostgreSQL backend; current credential provenance and secret equality are evaluated after the blocked client/grant/token lock. Authorized replacement writers serialize, with the last committed secret current.
durable_assertions: last committed secret hash/verifier/deadline and rotation timestamp are current
app and management deadlines remain unchanged
expired or replaced preverified authority cannot redeem grant/token
replacement write/audit failure preserves old credential and audit state

schedules.test_ref: test/lockspire/storage/client_lifetime_rollback_test.exs, test/lockspire/storage/client_secret_lifetime_rotation_race_test.exs, test/lockspire/storage/management_token_rollback_test.exs, and test/lockspire/storage/management_token_mutation_race_test.exs: focused late write/audit failure and rejected-promotion rollback assertions
schedules.post_wait_check: Not applicable to focused same-transaction rollback selections; contention-specific rollback cases are separately exercised in C-RACE-02 and C-RACE-03.
durable_assertions: complete client credential/verifier/version/deadline/metadata/enabled row equals pre-operation state
grant consumption and output token insertion roll back together
refresh family, device/CIBA, exchange inputs and audit rows remain unchanged on injected failure
failed operation returns no replacement credential or success audit

schedules.test_ref: test/lockspire/storage/client_lifetime_client_wait_test.exs and client_lifetime_grant_wait_test.exs: code redemption rechecks app equality and enabled/current state after client and code-row waits
schedules.post_wait_check: After the observed client/code row blocker is released, the redemption path samples the current time and client row again; equality and committed disablement reject stale redemption.
durable_assertions: authorization code/grant remains unconsumed after rejection
no output token or success audit is created
current disabled state is preserved
opposing subject/actor exchange waits complete with both current identities

schedules.test_ref: test/lockspire/storage/management_token_client_wait_test.exs: GET/PUT/DELETE reject equality/after-expiry only after confirmed row wait and lose authority after real replacement commits
schedules.post_wait_check: Each operation waits behind a distinct client-row holder, then checks current management credential identity and expiry before permitting the operation.
durable_assertions: expired or replaced management token cannot read/update/delete
committed replacement remains current
stale operation creates no mutation or success audit
already-authorized read linearizes before replacement as documented by its schedule

schedules.test_ref: test/lockspire/storage/client_lifetime_promotion_test.exs: secret replacement canonicalizes v0 historical date classes and preserves the unrelated management credential/deadlines
schedules.post_wait_check: Not a wait schedule; deterministic whole-row promotion assertions check current state.
durable_assertions: legacy version changes to v1
advisory historical deadlines become canonical nil on promotion
secret replacement preserves management credential and unrelated deadline
management promotion preserves secret verifier, metadata, and disabled state
